 684  def merge_intervals(
 685      intervals: Iterable[tuple[float, float]], *, tolerance: float = 1e-10
 686  ) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
 687      """Return the union of time intervals without double-counting overlaps."""
 688  
 689      ordered = sorted((float(left), float(right)) for left, right in intervals)
 690      merged: list[list[float]] = []
 691      for left, right in ordered:
 692          if right < left:
 693              raise ValueError("interval right endpoint precedes left endpoint")
 694          if not merged or left > merged[-1][1] + tolerance:
 695              merged.append([left, right])
 696          else:
 697              merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], right)
 698      return [(left, right) for left, right in merged if right - left > tolerance]

 701  def interval_duration(intervals: Iterable[tuple[float, float]]) -> float:
 702      """Measure the union of intervals."""
 703  
 704      return float(sum(right - left for left, right in merge_intervals(intervals)))
